question: current-AWQ c24/c32 L40S saturation bound
evidence_class: measured inputs plus derived conservative/optimistic bounds

derived_assumptions.optimistic_ceiling: perfectly convert every sampled mean GPU-idle fraction to useful work; zero new overhead
derived_assumptions.scheduler: summed queue time is not treated as wall-time share; no queue credit is granted
derived_assumptions.reliability: c16 all 32 requests completed; c24/c32 receive no unmeasured reliability credit
derived_assumptions.memory: linear c16 incremental envelope; fragmentation and allocator effects are unresolved

decision_reason: Even the perfect-idle-recovery ceiling is below the 562.050 tps hurdle; c32 also exceeds the linear memory envelope.
